entry_acceptance_rule: An entry must be supported by both independent decoders and at least one strong boundary/reference class: 16-byte-aligned post-INT3 boundary, direct CALL target, PE entrypoint, aligned .rdata/.data code pointer whose target begins after a RET in both decoders, explicit immediate callback address with the same target boundary rule, or direct JMP/tail target with the same boundary rule. Sets are deduplicated before counting.

Therefore 79,391 is a reproducible high-confidence machine-code entrypoint denominator, not a proof of the exact number of original C/C++ source-level functions.
policy: Use 79,391 as the current decompilation dashboard denominator for high-confidence machine-code function entrypoints.
